title: The Brain, Body, and Behaviour Dataset (1.0.0) - Experiment 1
description: Eye-tracking data from 27 participants who watched five short educational videos in two sessions: an attentive condition, followed by memory questions, and a distracted condition in which they silently counted backwards. The dataset includes gaze position, pupil size, blinks, saccades and fixations, plus questionnaire responses. It is Experiment 1 of the Brain, Body, and Behavior Dataset (BBBD), which supports research on attention and learning from educational video.
methods_description: Participants watched five informative videos while gaze and pupil size were tracked. In the attentive session they answered 11-12 multiple-choice factual questions after each video. In the distracted session they watched the same videos in the same order while silently counting backwards from a random prime number in steps of 7, with no test afterward. Video and question order was randomized.
